_note: status: 'working' = expander + layouts implemented AND a sample episode rendered and passed studio/verify.mjs + studio/textcheck.mjs. Narration in every sample is the unapproved SILMA voice (or eSpeak draft) — samples are previews until you approve a voice or import Clipchamp audio.

master_portrait.role: master transfer-history design (15 pages). Copy it per episode — never edit it in place.

style_kit_portrait.role: clean backgrounds exported to templates/kit/*.png for locally rendered scenes

modric_episode.role: copy of master pages for episodes/modric

story_thumbnail.role: landscape YouTube thumbnail (1280×720) — copy for each long-form episode

v1_original.role: first Bale design (preserved, not used for new episodes)

transfer-history.scenes: hook(canva) → clue×N(html) → countdown 5→1 → mystery(canva) → reveal(html photo or canva) → outro(canva)

guess-attributes.title_ar: خمّن اللاعب من الجنسية والنادي والرقم والمركز
guess-attributes.data: asOf (reference season — required, shown on screen), header, hook {kicker,title,subtitle,narration}, attributes[2–8] {label,value,size?,narration}, answer {name,sub,detail}, reveal/outro
guess-attributes.scenes: hook → attribute×N → countdown 5→1 → reveal (name card) → outro — all HTML, no Canva page needed

who-scored.data: match {competition,home,away,score,date,venue,minute}, recreation {label (required: states it is a recreation), path[[x,y]…] in pitch units, players[{x,y,team,label}], moveSeconds}, hints[] {text,short,narration}, answer, reveal/outro
who-scored.scenes: match card → tactical recreation (moving scorer '؟' + ball on a drawn pitch) → hints → countdown → reveal → outro. No match footage (copyrighted).

story.full_length: not produced — full-length outlines in episodes/*/narration/FULL_OUTLINE.md; render only after the 2-minute sample is approved

club-history.data: story structure + subject.club_ar (required); trophies layout for honours

analysis.data: story structure + data.criteria[] (required, shown and narrated) + at least one compare or formation scene
